sequence_points.name: Bamboo Triptych
sequence_points.description: A framed triptych featuring three vertical panels of black ink bamboo illustrations on light gray paper, mounted within a simple white mat and gold-colored frame. The composition emphasizes delicate brushwork and naturalistic bamboo forms.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Red and White Elements
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring dominant red and white forms, with hints of black and gray, arranged in a dynamic composition. The artwork is mounted on a wall within a white frame, suggesting an indoor gallery setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Vertical Composition
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract artwork featuring a series of thin, dark vertical lines on a light background. The piece is mounted on a plain wall, with minimal framing or border visible.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Ink Wash Composition
sequence_points.description: A vertical abstract painting featuring dark ink washes on a light background, with expressive, fluid brushstrokes concentrated toward the upper portion. The artwork is mounted on a white wall within a simple frame.
